div.span:
React 18 SPA (Port 3000)
- KPI Metric Cards
- Recharts Pie, Bar, and Line Charts
- Trending Hashtags and Top Keywords
- Aspect Sentiment Stacked Distribution
- Real-time Feed and Interactive Post Search

FastAPI Backend (Port 8000)
- In-Memory Cache (3s TTL)
- ContextVar source filter (?source=)
- REST Endpoints (/api/summary, /timeseries, etc.)
- WebSocket Stream (/ws/live @ 3s interval)

Spark Batch Analytical Job
- Daily Sentiment Pivot Aggregation
- Text NLP Pipeline (Tokenizer, Stopwords, Vectorizer)
- Spark MLlib LDA Topic Modeling (k=4)

HBase: processed_posts
cf 'd': data | cf 's': sentiment
cf 'n': nlp features
Salt: CRC32 % 8

HBase: analytics
cf 'a': pos, neg, neu

HBase: topics
cf 't': words, doc counts

Spark Streaming Engine (5s trigger)
- Schema Validation (id, source, text)
- Dead Letter Queue routing (posts.dlq)
- Text Cleansing and URL Stripping
- 7-day Watermark Deduplication

Partition NLP Workers
- VADER Sentiment Polarity Scoring
- Aspect Mining (8 Lexicons)
- Keyword and Hashtag Extractor
- Language Detection (langdetect)

Apache Kafka 3.8
Topic: posts.raw (3 partitions)
Topic: posts.dlq (1 partition)
